coverage_note: Denominator = CRL letters FDA itself publishes in the openFDA CRL transparency dataset for this year (FDA's published subset, not a census). Headline numerator = letters whose application number shows a later ORIGINAL approval action (submission_type ORIG, status AP) in the committed payloads - the closest public analogue of a successful resubmission. The 'any action' column also counts approved supplements on the same application, which need not relate to the letter, and is therefore an upper bound.
